annotations.title: Is this in the news, is it spiking, and how is the tone moving?

description: Currently switched off: it answers "not available" and charges nothing. Use when the user is monitoring a brand, competitor, executive, product or issue in the media: "how much press is Kraft Heinz getting?", "did coverage of this recall spike?", "is the tone turning negative?". Returns articles by week from GDELT's global news monitoring, spike weeks, share of all coverage, average tone and whether it is warming or cooling, the most frequent outlets, and the top headlines with links (never article text). Refuses before you are charged if nothing matches or the counts fail their checks. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: by week over days. To compare coverage with competitors, use run_news_share_of_voice; for online discussion, use run_social_pulse.
